brief:
A federal judge in New York granted a preliminary injunction today blocking the Trump administration from enforcing sanctions against the International Criminal Court, according to DAWN and Taxpayers Alliance Against Genocide. The two organizations said the ruling prevents the government from sanctioning groups advocating for Palestinian rights.

The order from the United States District Court for the Southern District of New York represents what the groups characterized as a victory for free speech protections.
dek: (NEW YORK, N.Y., October 13, 2026) – In a landmark victory for free speech and justice, the United States District Court for the Southern District of New York today granted a preliminary injunction blocking the Trump administration from enforcing its sanctions on the International Criminal Court (ICC) against DAWN and Taxpayers Alliance Against Genocide (TAAG), the two organizations said today.
title: U.S. court blocks Trump administration ICC sanctions on Palestinian rights groups
